title: The first letter, iv
logline: Thursday. Chloe, on the phone, from Portland: she read about it online. The strip draws her side of the call as a coat on a hook with a voice.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD on the phone — a cordless, 2007. BARNABY. On the wall, drawn as if it were in the room: a gray coat on a hook.
props: a gray coat on a hook

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man on a cordless phone in a garage studio with a gray coat hanging on a hook drawn as if it were in the room, a small dog
image.notes: Chloe's voice; the coat is Julian, the parenthesis. She is not drawn.

panels.composition: Wood, the phone against his shoulder, looking at the table leg.

balloons.text: It's a plush, Woody. It's not a — it's a PLUSH.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a man with a phone tucked against his shoulder looking down at a drafting table's leg

panels.composition: The coat on the hook. The voice from the phone, smaller. The dog looking at the coat.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a gray coat on a hook with a small dog looking up at it, a phone voice drawn small

panels.composition: Wood hanging up. The coat gone from the wall — it was never there. The dog looking at the bare hook.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man hanging up a cordless phone in a garage while a small dog looks at a bare hook on the wall where a coat was, no words

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: 'Tell Julian the table's level.' The coat on the hook, gone when he hangs up.
